sql.value: -- 本期 select ffvd.subject_id, ffvd.account_sets_id, coalesce(ffvd.currency_id, :localCurrency) as currency_id, ffs.balance_direction, coalesce(ffvd.auxiliary_detail_id, 0) as auxiliary_detail_id, sum(ffvd.debit_amount) as debit, sum(ffvd.credit_amount) as credit, sum(ffvd.debit_amount_for) as debit_for, sum(ffvd.credit_amount_for) as credit_for, sum(ffvd.credit_num) as credit_quantity, sum(ffvd.debit_num) as debit_quantity from fxy_financial_voucher_details ffvd inner join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffvd.account_sets_id = ffs.account_sets_id and ffvd.subject_id = ffs.id where ffvd.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffvd.year = :year and ffvd.month = :month #[and ffvd.carry_forward = :carryForward] #[and ffvd.cash_flow = :cashFlow] group by ffvd.subject_id, ffs.balance_direction, ffvd.currency_id, ffvd.auxiliary_detail_id

select ffvd.subject_id, ffvd.currency_id, coalesce(ffvd.auxiliary_detail_id, 0) as auxiliary_detail_id, sum(ffvd.debit_amount) as year_total_debit, sum(ffvd.credit_amount) as year_total_credit, sum(ffvd.debit_amount_for) as year_total_debit_for, sum(ffvd.credit_amount_for) as year_total_credit_for, sum(ffvd.credit_num) as year_total_credit_quantity, sum(ffvd.debit_num) as year_total_debit_quantity from fxy_financial_voucher_details ffvd inner join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffvd.account_sets_id = ffs.account_sets_id and ffvd.subject_id = ffs.id where ffvd.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffvd.year = :year and ffvd.month <= :month group by ffvd.subject_id, ffvd.currency_id, ffvd.auxiliary_detail_id

select ffvd.subject_id, ffvd.currency_id, coalesce(ffvd.auxiliary_detail_id, 0) as auxiliary_detail_id, if(ffs.balance_direction = '借', sum(ffvd.debit_amount - ffvd.credit_amount), sum(ffvd.credit_amount - ffvd.debit_amount)) as begin_balance, if(ffs.balance_direction = '借', sum(ffvd.debit_amount_for - ffvd.credit_amount_for), sum(ffvd.credit_amount_for - ffvd.debit_amount_for)) as begin_balance_for, if(ffs.balance_direction = '借', sum(ffvd.debit_num - ffvd.credit_num), sum(ffvd.credit_num - ffvd.debit_num)) as begin_quantity from fxy_financial_voucher_details ffvd inner join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffvd.account_sets_id = ffs.account_sets_id and ffvd.subject_id = ffs.id where ffvd.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffvd.voucher_date < :beginDate group by ffvd.subject_id, ffvd.currency_id, ffvd.auxiliary_detail_id

select ffvd.subject_id, ffvd.currency_id, coalesce(ffvd.auxiliary_detail_id, 0) as auxiliary_detail_id, if(ffs.balance_direction = '借', sum(ffvd.debit_amount - ffvd.credit_amount), sum(ffvd.credit_amount - ffvd.debit_amount)) as end_balance, if(ffs.balance_direction = '借', sum(ffvd.debit_amount_for - ffvd.credit_amount_for), sum(ffvd.credit_amount_for - ffvd.debit_amount_for)) as end_balance_for, if(ffs.balance_direction = '借', sum(ffvd.debit_num - ffvd.credit_num), sum(ffvd.credit_num - ffvd.debit_num)) as end_quantity from fxy_financial_voucher_details ffvd inner join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffvd.account_sets_id = ffs.account_sets_id and ffvd.subject_id = ffs.id where ffvd.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffvd.voucher_date < :endDate group by ffvd.subject_id, ffvd.currency_id, ffvd.auxiliary_detail_id

select ffvd.subject_id, ffvd.account_sets_id, ffvd.currency_id, coalesce(ffvd.auxiliary_detail_id, 0) as auxiliary_detail_id, if(ffs.balance_direction = '借', sum(ffvd.debit_amount - ffvd.credit_amount), sum(ffvd.credit_amount - ffvd.debit_amount)) as year_total, if(ffs.balance_direction = '借', sum(ffvd.debit_amount_for - ffvd.credit_amount_for), sum(ffvd.credit_amount_for - ffvd.debit_amount_for)) as year_total_for, if(ffs.balance_direction = '借', sum(ffvd.debit_num - ffvd.credit_num), sum(ffvd.credit_num - ffvd.debit_num)) as year_total_quantity from fxy_financial_voucher_details ffvd inner join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffvd.account_sets_id = ffs.account_sets_id and ffvd.subject_id = ffs.id where ffvd.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffvd.voucher_date < :beginYearDate group by ffvd.subject_id, ffvd.currency_id, ffvd.auxiliary_detail_id

select ffb.account_sets_id, ffs.balance_direction, ffs.full_name as subjectFullName, ffs.name as subjectName, ffs.code as subjectCode, ffs.leaf as leaf, subject_id, currency_id, auxiliary_detail_id, end_balance, end_quantity, end_balance_for, end_balance as begin_balance, end_quantity as begin_quantity, end_balance_for as begin_balance_for, end_credit_balance, end_credit_balance_for, end_debit_balance, end_debit_balance_for, end_credit_balance as begin_credit_balance, end_credit_balance_for as begin_credit_balance_for, end_debit_balance as begin_debit_balance, end_debit_balance_for as begin_debit_balance_for, year_total, year_total_credit, year_total_credit_for, year_total_begin_credit, year_total_begin_credit_for, year_total_credit_quantity, year_total_begin_debit, year_total_begin_debit_for, year_total_debit, year_total_debit_for, year_total_debit_quantity, year_total_for, year_total_quantity from `@value(:balanceTableName)` ffb inner join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffs.id = ffb.subject_id and ffb.account_sets_id = ffs.account_sets_id where ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.year = :year and ffb.period = :period

select ffb.account_sets_id, ffs.balance_direction, ffs.full_name as subjectFullName, ffs.name as subjectName, ffs.code as subjectCode, ffs.leaf as leaf, subject_id, currency_id, auxiliary_detail_id, end_balance, end_quantity, begin_balance, begin_quantity, year_total, year_total_credit, year_total_credit_for, year_total_credit_quantity, year_total_debit, year_total_debit_for, year_total_debit_quantity, year_total_for, year_total_quantity, end_balance_for, begin_balance_for as begin_balance_for from fxy_financial_balance ffb inner join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffs.id = ffb.subject_id and ffb.account_sets_id = ffs.account_sets_id where ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffs.leaf = 1 and ffb.year = :year and ffb.period = :period

select currency_id, auxiliary_detail_id, sum(debit) as debit, sum(credit) as credit, sum(debit_for) as debit_for, sum(credit_for) as credit_for, sum(debit_quantity) as debit_quantity, sum(credit_quantity) as credit_quantity, sum(begin_balance) as begin_balance, sum(begin_quantity) as begin_quantity, sum(end_balance) as end_balance, sum(end_quantity) as end_quantity, sum(year_total) as year_total, sum(year_total_credit) as year_total_credit, sum(year_total_credit_for) as year_total_credit_for, sum(year_total_credit_quantity) as year_total_credit_quantity, sum(year_total_debit) as year_total_debit, sum(year_total_debit_for) as year_total_debit_for, sum(year_total_debit_quantity) as year_total_debit_quantity, sum(year_total_for) as year_total_for, sum(year_total_quantity) as year_total_quantity, sum(begin_balance_for) as begin_balance_for, sum(end_balance_for) as end_balance_for from fxy_financial_balance ffb where ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.subject_id in (:subjectIdList) and ffb.year = :year and ffb.period = :period group by ffb.currency_id, ffb.auxiliary_detail_id

select ffb.subject_id, sum(ffb.debit) as debit_amount, sum(ffb.credit) as credit_amount from fxy_financial_balance ffb where ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.year = :year and ffb.period = :period and ffb.subject_id in (:subjectIds) group by ffb.subject_id
